stories.title: Differ Power unveils ‘9-in-1’ solar-storage heat pump
stories.description: The Chinese company has developed a residential heat pump system integrating a 6 kW hybrid inverter and supporting battery storage. The propane-based system comes in three versions with heating capacities ranging from 12 kW to 16 kW and can deliver hot water at temperatures of up to 75 C.

stories.title: Cyprus plans to deploy over 300 MW of battery storage
stories.description: With Cyprus having more than 1 GW of installed solar capacity against average electricity demand of around 650 MW, its government is looking to accelerate storage deployment to address rising solar curtailment and improve grid flexibility.

stories.title: Amazon says hackers' AI agents found and exploited 0-day with little human input
stories.description: The Cairn AI framework is proving to be a boon for defenders and attackers.

stories.title: The Download: AI’s gas power boom and a consciousness reality check
stories.description: This is today’s edition of The Download, our weekday newsletter that provides a daily dose of what’s going on in the world of technology.

stories.title: Supertake raises $20M to let AI agents turn your market predictions into stock portfolios
stories.description: Think you know where the market is headed? A startup called Supertake lets you put money behind your ideas without having to pick the stocks yourself.

stories.title: Megaspeed, the company at the center of the Jensen Huang scandal, appears headed for a US blacklist
stories.description: Megaspeed, which was previously led by Alice Huang, would be barred from doing business with U.S. companies unless those companies attained a special license from the federal government.

stories.title: Comedian impersonates Trump's dance moves, mocks trade talks at Canada press dinner
stories.description: The impersonator, Canadian comedian Mark Critch, poked fun at the US president's search for a new press secretary and US-Canada trade talks.

stories.title: How important are Nvidia and Jensen Huang to the US economy?
stories.description: The Nvidia chief executive has been at the centre of the artificial intelligence boom.

stories.title: Ancient rocks from the Moon’s far side rewrite the Solar System’s violent past
stories.description: Scientists studying ancient rocks from the Moon’s far side have uncovered surprising evidence that challenges decades of thinking about the Solar System’s violent past.

stories.title: Earth’s ancient oceans may have fooled scientists about its oxygen history
stories.description: Earth’s journey from an oxygen-starved world to a planet capable of supporting complex life may have unfolded very differently than scientists once believed. A new analysis suggests that oxygen accumulated in the atmosphere in three major stages, with the oceans taking millions or even hundreds of millions of years to catch up.

stories.title: Felicity Solar showcases 20 kWh low-voltage residential battery
stories.description: The Chinese manufacturer’s new lithium iron phosphate battery features a maximum charging power of 10.2 kW, a maximum discharging power of 12.8 kW, and a depth of discharge of 95%. Up to 15 units can be connected in parallel for a total storage capacity of 300 kWh.

stories.title: Ukraine sinks Russian warship, strikes cargo ships from Mediterranean to Baltic
stories.description: Russian missile corvette latest casualty as Ukraine strikes back in war at sea.
